heard: This is the family history of Esau. He is Edom in the hill country of Seir. Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan. Otter and Ohalibam and Basemath came there. Positions were too great to live together. The land could not support their livestock there. So Esau moved away from his brother Jacob and settled in the land that bears. His name When Shaul died Baal-Anam son of Achbor Succeeded as king When Baal-Anam died Anand succeeded him as king His city was Nepal His wife Mehetabel Daughter of Meza Daughter of Mesa
